turns.patient_response: Well, doctor, I guess what brought me in is that I just don't feel like myself anymore. I... I barely talk to people these days. I just kind of go flat and quiet. And work... turns.doctor_question: You mentioned the depression started not long after you moved. Did anything else significant happen around that time, or has anything else been troubling you since then — like problems with relationships, work stress, financial difficulties, or loss of someone close to you?
turns.patient_response:
Well, the move was a big part of it, but... I guess what really started troubling me was how things fell apart at work. I'm a janitor, and I've always been pretty reliable. But my supervisor started writing me up for missing routes and making repeated cleaning mistakes. I just... I couldn't keep my work routine straight anymore. 

And it wasn't just work. I stopped keeping up with church, and I haven't gone fishing in... I don't even know how long. I used to check in on a few people, you know, just to see how they were doing, but I stopped doing that, too. I just didn't have it in me. It got so bad at work that I finally went to the employee assistance program because I didn't know what else to do. I just couldn't keep up.

symptom_reasoning.S001: The patient reports making repeated cleaning mistakes at work, indicating careless errors.
symptom_reasoning.S004: The patient mentions missing routes and being unable to keep their work routine straight, showing failure to finish workplace duties.
symptom_reasoning.S025: The patient describes stopping previously enjoyed activities like fishing, attending church, and checking on people because they 'didn't have it in me', indicating a clear loss of interest and motivation.

turns.doctor_question: Over these past 14 months, have you been feeling guilty about things, or have you been blaming yourself — like feeling like you're worthless or that things are your fault?
turns.patient_response: Yeah, I have. I just... I keep thinking I failed everybody by losing my old place and not keeping my life together. It weighs on me a lot. Like, if the church pantry is short on supplies, or if a hallway gets missed somewhere, I somehow feel like that's on me, too. I just feel pretty worthless a lot of the time.

turns.doctor_question: Over these past 14 months, have you noticed that you move or speak more slowly than you used to, or do people ever comment that you seem to be moving or talking in slow motion?

turns.doctor_question: Over these past 14 months, have you had any thoughts about harming yourself or wishing you were dead?
